title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta17

## Non-blocking startup after map-artifact prewarming

This beta fixes a Home Assistant startup regression introduced with the beta14
current-cycle artifact prewarmer. On installations with a large retained History
or mixed vendor/History current-cycle source, artifact preparation could begin
while the Navimower config entry was still starting and make Home Assistant's
event loop appear stuck for an extended period.

- Do not start map-artifact prewarming while persistent state is being restored
  or while the first private-cloud refresh is still part of config-entry setup.
- Enable prewarming only after all awaited Navimower setup work and platform
  forwarding have completed; the actual request starts on the next event-loop
  turn and remains a background task.
- Move point-heavy retained-History current-cycle arbitration and source
  construction to Home Assistant's executor so large mowing histories cannot
  monopolize the event loop.
- Keep beta16's canonical Docked/Target zone arbitration unchanged, including the
  fix for periodic dock XY heartbeats reviving a retained previous target.
- Add regressions for deferred startup prewarming and executor-owned History
  arbitration.

No map geometry, cycle/reset ownership, MQTT tail, Schedule, gate intent, entity
IDs, Map Card API schema or mower-control behavior is intentionally changed.
